meta.description: Get loan-ready, match with the right lenders and track every application in one place.

pwa.updateReady: A new version of FundenFlo is ready.
pwa.installHint: Add FundenFlo to your home screen for quick access.
pwa.installed: FundenFlo is installed on this device.
pwa.offlineBody: Check your internet connection. Your information is safe, and you can continue when you are back online.

landing.eyebrow: Loans for India’s MSMEs and individuals
landing.title: Get loan-ready. Apply to the lenders that fit.
landing.subtitle: Answer a few questions, upload your documents once, see your readiness score and send your file only to lenders likely to say yes.
landing.partnerBody: Receive verified leads, file cases for your clients and track commissions.
landing.staffBody: Review submissions, manage products and run operations.

profile.title: Tell us what you need
profile.body: Loan type, amount and a few details about you or your business.

documents.title: Upload documents once
documents.body: Bank statements, ITR and GST returns, kept private and encrypted.

score.title: See your readiness
score.body: A clear score with what to improve before you apply.

lenders.title: Apply to matched lenders
lenders.body: Only lenders whose criteria fit you, with your consent for each.

landing.privacy: Your data is shared with a lender only after you agree. You can see, download or erase it any time.

login.title: Sign in or create an account
login.subtitle: We will send a 6-digit code to verify it is you.
login.referralHint: If a partner gave you a code, enter it here.
login.terms: By continuing you agree to the terms and privacy policy.
login.sent: A new code is on its way.

otp.title: Enter the code
otp.resent: A new code is on its way.

staff.title: Team sign in
staff.subtitle: For lenders and the FundenFlo team.
staff.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
staff.setupBody: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or a similar app, then enter the code it shows.

invite.title: Join FundenFlo
invite.subtitle: Set your name and password to accept the invitation.
invite.done: Invitation accepted for {email}. Sign in to set up your authenticator.

next.PARTNER_NOT_ONBOARDED: Complete your partner registration to continue.
next.PARTNER_PENDING_VERIFICATION: Your firm is being verified. Some features open after approval.
next.MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED: Choose how you want to use FundenFlo.
next.MEMBERSHIP_SUSPENDED: This role is suspended. Choose another role or contact support.

wrongArea.title: This area needs a different role
wrongArea.body: You are signed in as {context}. Switch to a role that can open this page.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.languageDescription: Choose the language for screens. Messages by SMS and push use English or Hindi.
profile.appDescription: Install FundenFlo on this device for quick access, even on slow networks.
profile.messageLanguageHint: Codes and updates are sent in this language.

security.devicesDescription: Places where you are signed in.
security.confirmSignOutBody: It will need to sign in again.
security.loginsDescription: Ways you can sign in to this account.
security.mobileDescription: Change the mobile number you sign in with. We will send a code to the new number.

consents.title: Your consents
consents.description: What you have agreed to and when. You can withdraw any consent; required ones may pause an application.
consents.confirmWithdrawBody: FundenFlo and lenders will stop using your data for this purpose. Applications that need it may pause.
consents.empty: You have not given any consents yet.
consents.optInsDescription: Choose how else we may contact you.

notifications.title: Update channels
notifications.description: Where we send updates about your applications, leads and payouts. Security codes and invitations are always sent.
notifications.pushHint: Alerts on devices where the FundenFlo app is installed.
notifications.oneRequired: Keep at least one channel on.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.description: Download a copy of your data, ask for a correction, or ask us to erase it. We reply within 30 days.

kindHint.access: A file with everything we hold about you, ready within minutes.
kindHint.correction: Tell us what is wrong and what it should be.
kindHint.erasure: We remove your data unless the law requires us to keep it, for example for an open or recent loan.

privacy.empty: You have not made any requests.

switch.title: Your roles
switch.description: One account can be a borrower, a partner firm member, a lender user or a FundenFlo team member.
switch.borrowerBody: Apply for loans for yourself or your business.
switch.becomePartnerBody: CAs, DSAs and connectors can register their firm.

home.title: Your applications
home.description: Track every loan application and see what to do next.
home.emptyBody: It takes a few minutes. You can save and continue any time.

start.title: New application
start.description: Tell us who is borrowing and what the loan is for.
start.category: What do you need the loan for?
start.businessNameHint: As on GST or bank records. Proprietors can leave this empty to use their own name.

reasons.NO_VERIFIED_LENDER_ROUTE: No verified lender offers this for you yet.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.pendingBody: Two FundenFlo team members check every new firm. You will get leads once it is approved.

signup.title: Register your firm
signup.description: Chartered accountants, DSAs and connectors can receive leads and file cases on FundenFlo.
signup.membershipHint: For CA firms. We check it on the public register.
signup.submitted: Registration submitted. We will notify you after verification.
signup.receivedBody: Two FundenFlo team members check every new firm, usually within two working days. We will send you an SMS when your firm is approved. Until then you can keep using FundenFlo as a borrower.

inbox.title: Submissions
inbox.description: Files sent to your organization by FundenFlo.

leads.title: Leads
leads.description: Every lead captured, imported or referred.
